$taxiId..write:
auth != null && (
          !data.exists() && newData.child('driverId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.exists() && data.child('driverId').val() === auth.uid ||
          root.child('users/' + auth.uid + '/role').val() === 'conductor'
        )
$taxiId..validate:
newData.hasChildren(['driverName','route','capacity','passengersOnboard','status','driverId','lastUpdated']) &&
          (newData.child('route').val() === 'SUN_CITY' || newData.child('route').val() === 'RUSTENBURG') &&
          newData.child('capacity').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('capacity').val() >= 1 &&
          newData.child('capacity').val() <= 22 &&
          newData.child('passengersOnboard').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('passengersOnboard').val() >= 0 &&
          newData.child('passengersOnboard').val() <= newData.child('capacity').val() &&
          newData.child('driverId').val() === auth.uid &&
          newData.child('status').val().matches(/^(loading|full|departed|breakdown)$/)

$waitId..write:
auth != null && (
          !data.exists() && newData.child('passengerId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.exists() && data.child('passengerId').val() === auth.uid ||
          root.child('users/' + auth.uid + '/role').val() === 'conductor'
        )
$waitId..validate:
!newData.exists() || (
          newData.hasChildren(['route','groupSize','timestamp','passengerId']) &&
          (newData.child('route').val() === 'SUN_CITY' || newData.child('route').val() === 'RUSTENBURG') &&
          newData.child('groupSize').isNumber() &&
          newData.child('groupSize').val() >= 1 &&
          newData.child('groupSize').val() <= 10 &&
          newData.child('passengerId').val() === auth.uid
        )
